mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen from -16.4 to -14.9 over the last four weeks, a steady narrowing gap indicating recovering foot traffic momentum that should continue over the next four weeks absent a shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved monotonically from -16.4 to -14.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days despite the prior four-week upward trend, the momentum mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility above 4.0 percent for two consecutive weeks signals deepening home-centric behavior that substitutes away from retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds 4.0 percent for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL reached 4.0 at t-0w after rising from 2.3 at t-3w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 4.0 for two weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent deep declines in WORKPLACES (ranging -17.7 to -25.6) reflect ongoing restriction or remote-work policy that suppresses commute-linked retail visits, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed or falling further over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stayed below -17 for all four observed weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -17, the policy-suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES jointly reduce the combined commute-and-errand chain that typically feeds retail visits; when both fall together the compounded effect depresses RETAIL_REC more than either alone over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both declined together at t-2w (-17.4 and -25.6)
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC improves over the next two weeks despite joint declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES below their four-week averages, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in PARKS mobility (from -7.1 to 7.6 in one week) indicates favorable weather or seasonal outdoor opportunity that substitutes for indoor retail and recreation trips, pulling RETAIL_REC lower in the immediate following week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -7.1 at t-1w to 7.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises in the week immediately following a PARKS jump greater than 10 points, the substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Consistently elevated GROCERY_PHARM mobility (never below 5.6 across four weeks) indicates households are concentrating shopping into essential-goods trips rather than discretionary retail, structurally capping RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM remained above 5.6 in every observed week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays persistently elevated above 5.6, the essential-substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT mobility crosses below -15 percent, reduced public transit usage directly limits access to retail districts for transit-dependent populations, producing a same-week drop in RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -14.4 at t-0w, approaching the -15 threshold after being at -17.4 at t-2w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week following a TRANSIT reading below -15, the transit-access mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A structural shift where WORKPLACES mobility stays deeply negative while RESIDENTIAL mobility trends upward together signals entrenched remote-work habits that permanently reduce trip-chaining to retail locations, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stayed below -17 while RESIDENTIAL rose from 2.3 to 4.0 over four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining below -17 and RESIDENTIAL remaining above 3.5, the structural remote-work mechanism is rejected.
